title: Special Regulations for Accessory Residential Parking Facilities
previewText: The applicable district regulations pertaining to permitted or required off-street parking facilities accessory to residential uses shall apply to all developments on waterfront blocks except as modified in this Section or in Section 62-45 (Supplementary Regulations for All Parking Facilities).
